name: get_take
description: Fetch one owned Sketch or Code take, optionally an exact version, for integration into your project. Code returns files from the saved source snapshot. Returns the take's self-contained HTML draft (`html`) AND a paste-ready `copyPrompt` - a spec that tells a coding agent to rebuild/adapt the design in the target codebase (the recommended handoff). Pass the full `projectId` UUID and 1-based `take`; version is 1-based. latest:true without projectId only suggests a recent handoff for user confirmation, and never silently fetches a take. FREE, including when AI is off. If ready is false, no rendered draft is available yet.

elements.description: Include the saved address map. Browser geometry is explicitly unavailable.

latest.description: Suggest the owner's recent handoff. Requires user confirmation before fetching.

projectId.description: The generation's projectId (structuredContent.projectId from a `generate` result).

select.description: Stable part/element addresses. Code also accepts exact saved file paths, source addresses, or src/file.tsx:10-20. Returns only selected source fragments.

take.description: 1-based take number to fetch (see `get_generation` or the 'Take N' preview label). Defaults to 1.

tokens.description: Include declared CSS custom properties; values are not computed browser styles.

version.description: Exact 1-based saved version. Omit for the latest saved version.
